module: Flowgraph node "Add Vehicle Group To Pool" (once_instant). Inserts all ids of the vehGroup table into the pool (pool:insertVeh for each). Requires the core_vehicleActivePooling module; the pool object comes from the Create Vehicle Pool node.
notes: The node's description ("Activates or deactivates a vehicle object in the pool") does not match the code, which adds a group to the pool.

workOnce.desc: Calls insertVeh for each id in the group.
